label: Lead Qualification Scorer
description: Applies BANT/MEDDIC or custom scoring frameworks to qualify sales leads. Evaluates budget, authority, need, timeline, and competitive position to prioritize pipeline.

options.label: MEDDIC (Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Identify Pain, Champion)

guidedInputs.label: Prospect company name
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Nordea Bank, Volvo Group, H&M

options.label: Inbound (form fill, content download, demo request)

guidedInputs.label: What do we know about this lead?
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe everything you know:
- Company size, industry, geography
- Who made contact and their role
- What they said they need or are trying to solve
- Any conversation notes
- Budget signals (explicit or implicit)
- Timeline signals
- Who else is involved in the decision
- Competitive context (are they talking to others?)

guidedInputs.label: What are we trying to sell them?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., AML gap analysis and remediation programme, SaaS platform annual licence, Strategy advisory retainer

guidedInputs.label: Custom qualification criteria (if applicable)
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe any company-specific qualification criteria not covered by the standard framework, e.g., must be in financial services, minimum company size EUR 50M revenue, must have a dedicated compliance team
